hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight font-bold text-white
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-semibold text-slate-100

components.header: Sticky header with glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#15131C]/80). Must contain the Credit Counter ('⚡ 30 Créditos') prominently, preferably with a subtle violet/cyan glowing border to emphasize AI. Do NOT use completely transparent background.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped, using gradient_ai for high-impact actions like 'Generar' or 'Aplicar IA', solid cyan for standard primary actions. Add hover state with brightness increase and scale up (using framer-motion).
buttons.secondary: Solid elevated surface with subtle white/10 border. Hover changes to white/20 border and text color brightens.
buttons.ghost: Transparent background, hover gets white/5 background.

cards.listing: Flat solid card for property listings. Image thumbnail (max-h-48, object-cover), title, photo count, and status badge. Subtle hover lift (-translate-y-1).
cards.editor_panel: Side panel in Editor using 'solid' surface if docked or 'glass' if floating. High density layout for AI adjustment sliders (Sky, Lighting, Declutter).
cards.photo_thumbnail: Square or 4:3 aspect ratio. Overlay on hover to show 'Editar' or 'Eliminar' actions. Status indicator badge for 'Original' or 'Imagen editada digitalmente'.

components.editor_canvas: The central area of the editor. Must dominate the screen. Uses a dark neutral background (#050505) to let the photo pop. Integrates a before/after slider overlay.
components.credit_modal: Confirmation modal (Shadcn Dialog) before applying AI edits. Shows cost ('Coste: 2 créditos') and remaining balance. Use warning colors if credits are insufficient.
components.job_queue: Floating toast or bottom panel showing processing status with a progress bar. Use violet/cyan gradient for the progress fill.

grids.marketing: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Hero uses col-span-full. Features use bento grid (Tetris grid: col-span-8 and col-span-4 combinations).
grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. Dense layout for listings and photo galleries.

layouts.marketing_page: Hero section with large before/after interactive image, clear value prop in Spanish, and CTA. Bento grid for features. Dark moody aesthetic.
layouts.dashboard_app: Top header with navigation and credit counter. Main content area with a grid of properties. Each property acts as a folder for its images and videos.
layouts.property_view: Breadcrumbs at top. Header with Property Title. Grid of photos. Upload dropzone prominently placed.
layouts.editor_view: Full-screen layout (h-screen). Top bar with 'Volver' and 'Guardar/Exportar'. Left/Right side panels (width 320px) for tools. Central flex-grow area for the image canvas.

motion.transitions: Use specific transitions, e.g., 'transition-colors duration-200', 'transition-transform duration-300 ease-out'. Avoid 'transition-all'.
motion.animations: Framer motion for page transitions, staggered list appearances in dashboards, and the before/after slider handle.
motion.micro_interactions: Buttons scale down slightly on tap (scale: 0.98). Hovering over a photo thumbnail shows a subtle violet glow.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over dark backgrounds meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Off-white text on #0B0A10 is highly readable.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0B0A10] for all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: Include aria-labels on AI tool toggles and the before/after slider.
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='credit-counter', data-testid='apply-sky-btn').

images.usage: Use as the 'Before' image in the marketing page hero slider.
Use as the 'After' image in the marketing page hero slider to demonstrate Twilight AI feature.
Use as placeholder thumbnails for property listings in the dashboard.
Use as the main image loaded in the editor canvas mockups.

libraries.components: shadcn/ui (customized for dark mode with border-white/5)

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a unified Dark Theme ONLY (Modo oscuro). Do not build a light theme toggle as per pro-media aesthetic requirements.
The UI must be entirely in Spanish ('Propiedades', 'Créditos', 'Editar', 'Imagen editada digitalmente').

Build the Editor View as a full-screen layout. The center should be a large canvas for the image. The side panel should contain a dense, pro-level set of controls for AI features (Cielo/Twilight, Declutter, Corrección de Luz/Color/HDR, Enderezar).
Implement a custom Before/After slider component overlay on the editor canvas. It should allow dragging left/right to compare original vs edited.
Ensure the Credit Counter ('⚡ 30') is prominently visible in the global header.
Before executing an AI edit from the side panel, trigger a confirmation modal (Shadcn Dialog) stating the cost ('Coste: X créditos') and requiring user confirmation.
Include an 'Imagen editada digitalmente' (Disclosure tag) badge clearly on images that have been processed.
The app must be a PWA and web responsive. Ensure mobile views gracefully handle the editor canvas and side panels (e.g., bottom sheet for tools on mobile).
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for marketing page bento layouts to achieve dynamic asymmetry. Use Shadcn for interactive dashboard and editor components.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Create depth using z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl).
Never apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions for interactive elements.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp with interaction animations).
Never use AI assistant emojis for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, transitions).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
NEVER use placeholder text for images, use provided media URLs.
